Preparing pixels
Score = 55% colour + 20% texture + 25% style tags

What is real here?

A small, inspectable retrieval algorithm.

  1. 1
    Read pixels

    Build a hue histogram and average RGB tone from the selected garment region.

  2. 2
    Measure texture

    Estimate edge density from neighbouring luminance changes.

  3. 3
    Compare meaning

    Calculate Jaccard similarity across explicit tags such as tartan, pleated or velvet.

  4. 4
    Rank candidates

    Normalise the chosen weights and sort by the combined score—entirely in the browser.

This is not a trained fashion model. Pixel analysis runs live when an image host permits it; otherwise the card is clearly marked as using its stored visual descriptors. The ranking formula remains genuine and reproducible.
